encoded as uncomputable rather than approximated.","Minimum age 18 years and product choice (Jynneos) not separately encoded beyond the age criterion.","Minimum interval of 28 days between dose 1 and dose 2 is not represented; the numerator only counts 2 doses.","The age criterion reflects the child schedule scope ('Age 18 years'); adults over 18 are covered by the adult schedule, not this rule.","Pregnancy: no ACIP recommendation for Jynneos use in pregnancy due to lack of safety data;
